subject: On-prem isolation & SOC 2 / GDPR validation — assessment kickoff
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@healthverity.com>, security@healthverity.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: On-prem isolation & SOC 2 / GDPR validation — assessment kickoff

Hi Maria / HealthVerity SecOps team,

Thanks again for taking time today — quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can scope the Private/VPC evaluation. Short list of what we need to validate on our side: 

- SOC 2 status: current type (I/II), date of last audit, are reports available under NDA
- Data classification & residency: any customer data that will be processed/stored that is considered EU personal data or PHI (HIPAA)
- Deployment topology: a simple diagram showing where model inference would run (on-prem zone names, outbound egress paths, NAT/proxy usage)
- Network controls: firewall rules, allowed egress destinations, proxy inspection, and support for explicit IP allowlisting
- Air-gap / offline options: confirm whether full air-gapped installs are feasible and the mechanisms for model updates (sneakernet, signed packages, HSM/KMS integration)
- Vendor questionnaire: we'd like to kick off our vendor RFI — attached is an initial workbook to speed answers.

Can you confirm the SOC 2 status and whether you can share a redacted report? Also please attach any existing topology diagrams (PNG/PDF) and tell us who on your side will be the lead for technical evidence.

Proposed next steps:
1) HealthVerity shares SOC2 status + topology by Tue 21 Mar
2) Redwood assigns a security lead to run through the RFI and a 30m follow-up call the week of 3/26
3) If PHI is in scope, we’ll outline BAA questions and any additional controls we’ll need for Private deployment

Attachments: HealthVerity_RFI_Initial.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference — production-first inference runtime

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@healthverity.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@healthverity.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: On-prem isolation & SOC 2 / GDPR validation — assessment kickoff

Michael — thanks for the clear recap and the workbook. Quick answers from our side to help you triage: 

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II in Dec 2027. Our auditor will provide a redacted report under NDA; I can start the NDA process today.
- GDPR / data residency: We are a US-headquartered vendor but process EU personal data for some customers. We use a regional on-prem option for EU customers on request.
- PHI / HIPAA: We do host PHI for a small set of customers under BAAs. For this prospective deployment, we need to understand whether PHI will be routed to our inference stack.
- Topology: attaching a high-level topology export (topology-draft-v1.png). It's not final but should give you enough to start.
- Air-gap: We have experience with air-gapped installs; updates are delivered as signed tarballs via secure courier or sftp to an air-gapped gateway; we can also support customer-managed KMS for key wrapping.

Security lead: security@healthverity.com (cc’d) will own the RFI responses. Please send your NDA link and we’ll have the SOC 2 redacted report to you within 5 business days after NDA.

Thanks — happy to take the follow-up call with an engineer if useful.

—Maria
Maria Lopez
Director, Infrastructure Security, HealthVerity
M: +1 (617) 555-2244
[Attachment: topology-draft-v1.png (image/png)]
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@healthverity.com>, security@healthverity.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: On-prem isolation & SOC 2 / GDPR validation — assessment kickoff

Maria — perfect, really helpful. Two quick clarifications and our proposed evidence path: 

1) NDA: I’ve created a short mutual NDA via DocuSign. Link here: https://app.docusign.com/NDAs/HV-014 (please route to your legal). Once signed we’ll provide the redacted SOC 2 immediately.
2) PHI scope: Monica / Karthik — can you confirm the specific questions we should put in the RFI about PHI handling and BAA pre-reqs? Suggested: data-at-rest encryption (customer-managed keys), audit log retention, and ability to disable telemetry.

Proposed evidence path (we’ll own collection):
- Step A: Sign NDA -> HealthVerity provides SOC 2 redacted report + any compensating control notes
- Step B: HealthVerity uploads final topology + firewall rule examples (screenshots or export) to the SharePoint link I shared
- Step C: Redwood security runs the RFI workbook and returns a gap map; propose 30m sync with your SecOps to walk gaps

Air-gap follow-up: please confirm whether signed-install tarball is SHA256-signed and whether the install requires outbound callbacks for license checks. If there are license callbacks, we’ll need an offline license mechanism.

Proposed slot for follow-up: Thu 29 Mar, 11:00–11:30 PT — will that work for you and your SecOps engineer?

Thanks,

Michael

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@healthverity.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: On-prem isolation & SOC 2 / GDPR validation — assessment kickoff

Adding a quick operations note from the security review side — we’ll lead the RFI and evidence collection. Action items on our side: 

- I’ll take point on the RFI workbook and will add PHI-specific items (customer-managed KMS, telemetry toggles, audit log format & retention).
- Karthik — please prepare the Private deployment questionnaire checklist (network allowlist, IP ranges, HA topology, cert rotation) so we can get that to HealthVerity during the NDAs window.
- Michael — I’ll coordinate the 30m follow-up and invite an infra engineer from our side.

Maria — once the NDA is signed we’ll upload a pre-filled RFI with the exact fields we’ll need filled; happy to take a call to walk the items.

Monica Patel
Security Programs, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
[Note: Monica attached the RFI workbook and a short checklist — see HealthVerity_RFI_Initial.xlsx]
